seo__browser_title: Oakdene House Foundation — Real Support for Real Life
seo__search_description: Oakdene House Foundation supports people and families in Fairfield, Western Sydney affected by addiction, hardship and homelessness. Free counselling, community programs, kitchen and more.
hero__heading: Practical support, real connection, and a place to take the next step.
hero__subheading: Oakdene House Foundation supports people and families facing addiction, hardship, homelessness, and life challenges through practical help, counselling, community programs, and connection to the right support.
mission__heading: Support that meets people where they are
mission__text: Oakdene is a community charity based in Fairfield, Western Sydney. We work alongside people and families with practical support, connection, and pathways to further help.
mission__text_2: At Oakdene House, we believe real change happens when people feel safe, seen and supported. Our work brings together counselling, peer connection and practical care so people can access help that feels human, local and achievable.
mission__text_3: From individual counselling and group recovery programs to our kitchen, laundrette and boutique, every part of Oakdene is built around restoring hope and creating pathways forward.
mission__image_alt: Oakdene House Foundation centre building exterior
stats__text: Over 60% of participants seek continued assistance after treatment or counselling at our addiction centre.
video__intro: Hear from people in recovery, our counsellors and the people who started Oakdene House.
video__label: Play video: Oakdene House Foundation, our story
final_cta__heading: Need support or not sure where to start?
final_cta__subheading: Reach out to the Oakdene team and we will help you work out the best next step.

data__services.title: Counselling and Support
data__services.summary: One-on-one support to help you understand what you are facing and find a path forward that feels achievable.

data__services.title: Life Choices Program
data__services.summary: A 6-week group program focused on recovery, connection and building practical life skills in a supportive environment.

data__services.title: Oakdene Kitchen
data__services.summary: Free nutritious meals for eligible community members every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, 12pm–2pm.

data__services.title: Ladies Boutique
data__services.summary: A welcoming space offering affordable clothing and salon support for women. No woman is turned away due to financial difficulty.
